explication: DevOps Bash Tools is a command-line toolkit for operating local systems, cloud platforms, data services, developer platforms, and CI/CD systems. The principal workflow is: an operator selects a domain-specific shell tool, the tool performs an external query or mutation, and results are emitted to the terminal. The tree supports broad capability branches, but only the sampled macOS Python utility was inspected in source; relationships between individual scripts and shared libraries are therefore shown conservatively.
